items.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996
items.q: But Van Morrison just called me the other day. He’s called me three times and a couple of times just to say hello.

ctx.x: Has the music helped to make it any better?

No. No. What has happened is, you have some wonderful people in music, like Bonnie Raitt, Van Morrison, real, but you’ve got a lot of phonies in the music business, who could help bridge that gap. Like the Rolling Stones, who couldn’t keep a beat if you give them twenty drums. Mick Jagger could learn a lot by putting a black artist on some of his concerts. Do you hear what I’m saying? He’s stolen so much from us. I’m not bitter but I am aware of what they’ve done, and it hurts sometimes. But Van Morrison just…
days this month. Now we are so tight that there was no money discussed. You know why? Because he’s going to pay me what I’m worth.
